title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 7: Jerusalem is put under guard and the register of the first returning exiles is found.

questions.text: Whom did the narrator put in charge of Jerusalem along with his brother Hanani?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:2 says, "I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem."

answers.text: Eliashib the high priest
Shemaiah the son of Delaiah
Meshullam the son of Berechiah
Hananiah the governor of the fortress

questions.text: When were the gates of Jerusalem allowed to be opened?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:3 says: "Don't let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot."

answers.text: Not until the sun was hot
Only on the Sabbath
At the first light of dawn
Only when the king's letter arrived

questions.text: How is the city described in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:4 says the city was wide and large, but the people were few and the houses were not built.

answers.text: Small and crowded with people and houses
Full of new houses but without a wall
Wide and large, but with few people and unbuilt houses
Empty of all people and animals

questions.text: What book did the narrator find?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:5 says, "I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first."

answers.text: The book of the law of Moses
The genealogy of those who came up first
The book of the chronicles of the kings of Persia
The letters of Sanballat

questions.text: Who had carried the people away into captivity?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:6 says Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried them away.

answers.text: Artaxerxes the king of Persia
Pharaoh the king of Egypt
Tobiah the Ammonite servant
Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon

questions.text: Who is named first among the leaders the returning exiles came with?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:7 begins the list with Zerubbabel, then Jeshua and Nehemiah.

answers.text: Zerubbabel
Mordecai
Mispereth
Bilshan

questions.text: Why were some priests removed from the priesthood?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:64 says they searched for their genealogical records but couldn't find them.

answers.text: They had refused to help build the wall
They had married daughters of Sanballat
They could not find their genealogical records
They had eaten the most holy things

questions.text: Until when were these priests not to eat of the most holy things?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:64-65 says the governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

answers.text: Until the seventh month
Until a priest stood up with Urim and Thummim
Until the wall was dedicated with joy
Until the governor returned from Susa

questions.text: How large was the whole assembly?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:66 says the whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty.

answers.text: Seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven
Twelve thousand
Six thousand seven hundred twenty
Forty-two thousand three hundred sixty

questions.text: What did the governor give to the treasury?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:70 says he gave one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins and five hundred thirty priests' garments.

answers.text: One thousand darics of gold, fifty basins and priests' garments
Twenty thousand darics of gold and silver minas
Two hundred forty-five mules and camels
Sixty-seven priests' garments and nothing else
